name: Bundle Size Analyzer
description: Inspect esbuild metafile contributions, import paths, directory treemaps and explicit output comparisons offline.
boundary: Selected metadata only · No builds or source reads · No inferred module compression sizes

imports.empty: No imports recorded in this scope.

trace.title: Import path
trace.found: One path verified in the input graph
trace.limited: 64-level budget reached; complete path is undetermined
trace.unavailable: No verifiable entry path is provided by this metadata
trace.boundary: Evidence comes from the metafile input graph: one verified path, not a unique runtime causal chain. Shared chunks are traced from reachable declared entries.

tree.title: Contribution treemap
tree.limited: At most 256 tiles and 24 directory levels. Remaining groups are aggregated as Other; all modules remain available in paginated lists.

compare.hint: Identical paths match automatically. Explicitly pair outputs with changed hashes; similar names are never guessed. Each output belongs to at most one pair. Pairings last for this session.

empty.hint: Open a metafile JSON produced during an esbuild build. Load a second report to compare. Contributions use bytesInOutput; original source size is separate.

help: Read-only esbuild metafiles: 16 MiB each, 20,000 inputs, 2,000 outputs, 100,000 import edges and 100,000 contributions; JSON depth 64, paths 2,048 bytes, byte counts and sums at most 2^53-1.

Contributions use bytesInOutput, separately from source bytes. Positive output-minus-contribution differences remain unattributed. Over-attribution gets diagnostics and a chart scaled by the contribution sum.

Click directories to drill down and modules to inspect one verified input path and original imports. Only exact metadata references are followed; externals stay external. No source reads, builds or network access.

Treemaps have at most 256 tiles, grouping the remainder as Other. All modules remain available through backend pagination. Directory depth is 24; import traces are limited to 64 levels. No module gzip/Brotli estimates or unsupported tree-shaking claims.

Two reports match exact paths automatically; other paths remain added/removed until manually paired. Hashed outputs are never matched by approximate filenames. Output byte deltas and module contribution deltas are separate.

Reports live only in the current plugin instance. No database is created. CSV/JSON/Markdown follow the current directory, search or comparison scope. Copy limit 64 KiB; export limit 64 MiB. Tasks can be cancelled; failed/cancelled loads retain the prior cache.
